<script type="text/javascript">
        
    $("#Email").focus();
    
    $(".forgot-password-link").click(function (e) {
        location.href = "/Account/EmailPasswordReset?email=" + $("#Email").val();
        e.preventDefault();
    });
    function fieldsFilled() {
        return $("#Email").val() != "" && $("#Password").val() != "";
    }
    $(function () {
